verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a secret-scanning CLI. A security scanner could plausibly offer AI-generated triage or remediation suggestions, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only rule-based detection, baselines, allowlists, composite rules and PR comments from gitleaks-action, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
